FLIGHT DIRECTIVES & CONTROLS

FLIGHT CIRCUIT

The Aero-Dart Mk IV performs an automated test flight circuit around Pad 01: vertical ascent, landing gear retraction, forward acceleration past 4 navigation waypoints (Alpha, Bravo, Charlie, Delta), and precision descent back to pad touchdown.

CAMERA CONTROLS

  • Rotate: Left Mouse Drag / Touch Drag
  • Zoom: Mouse Wheel / Touch Pinch / + - Buttons
  • Pan: Right Mouse Drag / Two-finger Drag
  • Camera Modes: Orbit, Dynamic Chase, Tower Cam, Cockpit
